product_name: ASUS TUF GT501 Tempered Glass RGB PC Gaming Case
product_description:
Build your battlestation with the TUF Gaming GT501 Case featuring seven drive bays, USB 3.0 front panel, vertical GPU support and magnetic dust filters. Stay cool in battle with numerous cooling options including room for seven 120mm fans, two 360mm radiators, or custom water cooling with pre-drilled mounting holes.
TUF Gaming GT501 is crafted from up to 1.5mm-thick galvanized steel for enhanced durability in understated industrial style, and has a special coating that resists scuffs and scratches. It's fitted with two ergonomic, woven-cotton handles, rigorously built to support up to 30kg.
With a full-height, smoked-glass side panel, TUF Gaming GT501 lets you show off your build from top to bottom – so your components, customizations and Aura illuminations are all clearly visible. This panel is tempered for strength, and hinged at the bottom for opening ease.
Fitted RGB-enabled fans enable to work with the Aura-supported motherboards. With exclusive ASUS Aura Sync lighting technology, TUF Gaming GT501 provides ambient lighting that can be synchronized with other Aura Sync-enabled components.
TUF Gaming GT501's trio of 120mm Aura Sync RGB fans each contains 11 blades, and deliver high-static-pressure flow for targeted cooling. There's a high-airflow 140mm PWM fan for wider heat removal. It's also easy to upgrade cooling when you need, with up to seven mounting points for installation.
The case has space reserved both front- and top-mounted 360mm water-cooling radiators plus a 140mm radiator at the rear for future-proof chills. The interior is also laid out with lots of user-friendly design touches, providing a foundation for DIY builds that are easy to keep clean, tidy and cool.
Removable dust filters prevent airborne particulates from entering TUF Gaming GT501, keeping your system's internals looking as good as new for longer. The top and front filter are magnetic for a tight seal, and quick removal and cleaning, while the lower dust-trap is easily slid in and out.

product_description:
Fountain Valley, CA – August 5, 2019 – Kingston Digital, Inc., the Flash memory affiliate of Kingston Technology Company, Inc., a world leader in memory products and technology solutions, today announced it is shipping the A2000 NVMe™ PCIe SSD. The single-sided M.2 drive is Kingston’s next-gen entry-level, consumer NVMe PCIe SSD utilizing 3D NAND. A2000 delivers efficient performance, lower power and lower heat all at a lower price, making it the perfect storage upgrade solution for Ultrabook™ and notebook users.
A2000 is an affordable storage solution with impressive read / write speeds up to 2,200 / 2,000MB/s1, respectively, thus delivering 3x the performance of a SATA SSD. It is ideal for entry-level users and DIY system builders who appreciate responsiveness and ultra-fast loading times. A2000 is a self-encrypting drive that supports end-to-end data protection using 256-bit AES Hardware-based encryption that allows the usage of independent software vendors with TCG Opal 2.0 security management solutions including Symantec™, McAfee™, WinMagic® and others. The drive also has built-in eDrive support, a security storage specification for use with BitLocker.
“Kingston is proud to release the next generation of its entry-level NVMe PCIe SSD. With a single-sided slim M.2 design, A2000 works to its full potential when installed in a Ultrabook or other small form factor system making it the perfect drive for those seeking to upgrade their PC,” said Justin Karasek, SSD business manager, Kingston. “Plus, with the drive being self-encrypted, users can trust that their data is protected and secure when used with the right TCG Opal 2.0 management solution.”

product_name: Kingston (1TB) A2000 NVMe PCIe M.2 SSD
product_description:
Fountain Valley, CA – August 5, 2019 – Kingston Digital, Inc., the Flash memory affiliate of Kingston Technology Company, Inc., a world leader in memory products and technology solutions, today announced it is shipping the A2000 NVMe™ PCIe SSD. The single-sided M.2 drive is Kingston’s next-gen entry-level, consumer NVMe PCIe SSD utilizing 3D NAND. A2000 delivers efficient performance, lower power and lower heat all at a lower price, making it the perfect storage upgrade solution for Ultrabook™ and notebook users.
A2000 is an affordable storage solution with impressive read / write speeds up to 2,200 / 2,000MB/s1, respectively, thus delivering 3x the performance of a SATA SSD. It is ideal for entry-level users and DIY system builders who appreciate responsiveness and ultra-fast loading times. A2000 is a self-encrypting drive that supports end-to-end data protection using 256-bit AES Hardware-based encryption that allows the usage of independent software vendors with TCG Opal 2.0 security management solutions including Symantec™, McAfee™, WinMagic® and others. The drive also has built-in eDrive support, a security storage specification for use with BitLocker.
“Kingston is proud to release the next generation of its entry-level NVMe PCIe SSD. With a single-sided slim M.2 design, A2000 works to its full potential when installed in a Ultrabook or other small form factor system making it the perfect drive for those seeking to upgrade their PC,” said Justin Karasek, SSD business manager, Kingston. “Plus, with the drive being self-encrypted, users can trust that their data is protected and secure when used with the right TCG Opal 2.0 management solution.”

product_description:
The MWE White offers a simple, reliable way to power your system safely and efficiently at a low cost. The 80 PLUS White efficiency rating, DC-to-DC + LLC circuit design, single +12V rail, active PFC, and temperature sensitive HDB fan offer a power supply unit that stays true to its original purpose. This PSU will handle all your core computing needs with none of the hassles or challenges of additional specialty features, software synchronization, or other bells and whistles. Just plug it into your system and get to work. For a great core computing experience, you can’t go wrong with the MWE White.
It’s important to understand what efficiency is and what the ratings actually mean. The efficiency rating indicates how much power is retained and/or lost when transferring it from the wall to your components. It does not indicate the overall quality of the PSU. A PSU doesn’t need an 80 PLUS Gold rating to be safe and reliable. And a PSU with an 80 PLUS Gold rating isn’t necessarily either of those things. The MWE White guarantees a typical efficiency of 85% while being both safe and reliable.
Cooler Master now reports Cybenetics noise and efficiency ratings for current power supply units where applicable.
The constant struggle between cooling and noise is as old as the consumer PC industry itself. Keeping your components cool without having to hear about it while you work is still one of the greatest challenges for all fan based cooling technologies. The MWE White’s solution to this problem is a thermally sensitive 120mm HDB fan. It spins based on the system’s temperature, constantly adjusting to keep your PSU running smoothly and safely with the minimum amount of noise required.
Getting power from the wall to the PSU and then to your components is a tricky situation. The power comes in one voltage level, but your components need a different one. That power has to first be transferred to/through a converter in order to make it safe for your parts to use without overloading. The lines/rails used to initially move power from the wall to the converter need to be reliable and consistent to ensure your system’s overall performance. That’s why the MWE White only uses one +12V rail for this process. This way all the components in your system are constantly fed the same power from the same source in order to guarantee consistency between all connections.
Power comes in multiple voltage levels. The wall delivers power in one voltage level but your components each need a specific voltage to operate properly. The process of converting raw power from the wall to the multiple voltage levels your components need requires special components to complete this process quickly, efficiently, and safely. The MWE White’s DC-to-DC + LLC technology was painstakingly crafted to accomplish this goal. The Dual Forward circuit layout has been designed to convert 12V power to 3V and 5V levels with minimal ripple noise, 80 PLUS efficiency, and reduced risk to your connected components.

product_description:
The EK-KIT P240 is the ultimate liquid cooling kit dedicated to all users who seek the best price-performance ratio on the market! Everything you need to assemble your first custom loop. You don't have to worry about compatibility issues or being nervous about the right amount of fittings or tube length. If you are a beginner, this is a great place to start!
This kit brings the following components, selected from our wide range of quality products:
EK-Supremacy EVO - universal CPU water block that fits all modern CPU sockets with a universal mounting mechanism that offers error-preventing, tool-less installation. The result is an easy installation which brings perfect performance every time. EK-Supremacy EVO is our flagship CPU water block and it is truly the best product for performance seeking enthusiasts.
EK-CoolStream PE 240 radiator - it gives this kit its name - offers best cooling capacity in the 40mm thick radiator class: Double stack copper fins provide massive surface area while the parallel flow cooling chambers reduce hydraulic flow resistance to a minimum. Built for EK-Vardar 120mm high static pressure fans, these radiators are optimized for maximum heat dissipation across entire fan operational range thus delivering exceptional performance at both low- and high airflow operation.
EK-Vardar - industrial grade high-static pressure computer cooling fan, designed and built primarily for highest-performance computer liquid cooling systems. EK-Vardar is simply the best choice for computer radiator cooling as it provides unmatched performance throughout the entire operating range.
EK-XRES 140 Revo D5 PWM (incl. pump) - high-performance water cooling pump with integrated reservoir. The core of the unit is the market-proven Xylem D5 PWM water pump. The unit features a fully rounded design thus offering greater usability, allowing installation at any angle within 360° of rotation. Special rubber shock absorber is used to de-couple the main pump body from the mounting clip for silent operation, free of vibration induced noise. Additionally, horizontal and vertical positioning are supported for easier tube routing possibilities.
EK-DuraClear - 2 meters of the premium quality PVC tubing, guaranteed to be free of plasticizer leaching related issues.
EK-CryoFuel Clear Concentrate - EK-CryoFuel Clear is a pure, non-toxic coolant based on the patent pending chemical formula, which prevents the creation of any sediments in the liquid cooling loop. The 100mL concentrate is to be mixed with distilled water in ratio 1:9 to form 1L of ready-to-use coolant. To make mixing the concentrate with distilled easier, EK recommends the use of filling bottle (not included) that is also designed to make a loop filling process much easier.
The kit is easy to install, use and maintain, a thorough installation manual is included. Every item in this kit can be purchased separately, further descriptions and specifications of individual items can be found in EK webshop.
The majority of components have been pre-assembled resulting in quick and painless installation procedure. Once installed, this kit is a full custom loop solution. It can be upgraded with additional water blocks and components, such as additional radiators.
EK-KIT P240 complete list of items:- Universal CPU water block: EK-Supremacy EVO (incl. product_name: Dahua LM27-E341AY 27" QHD IPS Gaming Monitor
product_description:
The Dahua LM27-E341AY is a 27-inch QHD IPS gaming monitor engineered for competitive and enthusiast gamers who demand the highest achievable refresh rate at 2560×1440 resolution — without compromising on colour accuracy, visual quality, or display fidelity. Featuring a 275Hz high refresh rate, industry-leading 0.5ms OD response time, HDR10 support, 95% DCI-P3 wide colour gamut, Adaptive Sync, and dual DisplayPort 1.4 with dual HDMI inputs — the LM27-E341AY is the pinnacle of Dahua's QHD gaming monitor lineup and one of the fastest QHD IPS displays available at any price point.
QHD 2560×1440 — RESOLUTION AND SPEED WITHOUT COMPROMISE
The LM27-E341AY delivers 2560×1440 QHD resolution at 275Hz — a combination that eliminates the traditional trade-off between resolution and refresh rate that forces gamers to choose between a sharp 1440p image and a fast FHD display. At 27 inches, QHD achieves approximately 108 PPI pixel density — where individual pixels are imperceptible at normal viewing distances, producing a naturally crisp, detailed image across games, creative content, and professional applications. Every environment texture, UI element, and distant object is rendered with the clarity that FHD cannot deliver, while the 275Hz frame delivery speed ensures that clarity is maintained in full motion.
IPS PANEL — 95% DCI-P3, 178° VIEWING ANGLES, CONSISTENT COLOUR
The LM27-E341AY's IPS (In-Plane Switching) panel combines the colour accuracy and viewing angle consistency of professional display technology with the fast response times demanded by competitive gaming. 95% DCI-P3 wide colour gamut coverage reproduces a significantly broader range of colours than standard sRGB monitors — delivering deeper reds, more vibrant greens, and richer blues across game art, cinematic content, and creative projects with accuracy that meets professional post-production colour standards. IPS guarantees consistent colour reproduction across the full 178° horizontal and 178° vertical viewing cone — with no colour shift or contrast falloff at off-axis positions.
275Hz REFRESH RATE — THE FASTEST QHD IPS DISPLAY IN THE DAHUA LINEUP
At 275Hz, the LM27-E341AY refreshes 275 times per second at full 2560×1440 resolution — making it the highest refresh rate QHD monitor in the Dahua gaming range. The difference between 275Hz and 200Hz at QHD is perceptible: smoother character animation, sharper tracking during fast turns, reduced perceived input lag, and more fluid cursor movement during rapid mouse input. For competitive players who have already maximised their GPU performance at QHD, the 275Hz ceiling ensures the display is never the limiting factor in frame delivery.
0.5MS OD RESPONSE TIME — THE FASTEST PIXEL TRANSITION IN THE DAHUA RANGE
The 0.5ms OD (Overdrive) response time — measured as Moving Picture Response Time with overdrive enabled — is the fastest response specification in the Dahua gaming monitor lineup. At 0.5ms OD, pixel transitions complete in half a millisecond, eliminating all perceptible ghost trails, motion blur, and pixel smearing behind fast-moving objects at full 275Hz. For competitive FPS, battle royale, and racing titles where motion clarity is directly linked to target acquisition and reaction time, 0.5ms OD at 275Hz represents the current ceiling of IPS gaming display performance.
HDR10 — HIGH DYNAMIC RANGE SUPPORT
The LM27-E341AY supports the HDR10 standard, enabling display of high dynamic range content with expanded luminance range — producing brighter highlights, deeper shadows, and more nuanced midtone gradation compared to standard dynamic range (SDR) output. HDR10-compatible games, streaming content, and video files are displayed with the extended tonal range the LM27-E341AY's IPS panel and E-LED backlight can deliver — enhancing cinematic and immersive content beyond the SDR experience.
ADAPTIVE SYNC — ELIMINATE TEARING & STUTTERING AT QHD
Adaptive Sync technology dynamically synchronises the monitor's 275Hz refresh rate to the GPU's output frame rate in real time — eliminating screen tearing at QHD resolutions where GPU frame rates vary more significantly under load. Whether the GPU is producing 120fps during intensive scenes or 275fps in lighter environments, Adaptive Sync maintains smooth, tear-free frame delivery without the input latency penalty of traditional V-Sync — keeping QHD gaming consistently fluid across variable GPU load conditions.
300 cd/m² BRIGHTNESS — E-LED BACKLIGHT
The E-LED backlight delivers 300 cd/m² of typical brightness — maintaining clear, well-exposed visuals across gaming rooms and creative workspaces in standard ambient lighting conditions. HDR peak brightness extends beyond the SDR baseline for HDR10 content rendering.
HARDWARE-BASED ANTI-BLUE LIGHT & FLICKER-FREE
Hardware-level blue light filtering physically reduces high-energy blue light wavelength emission at the backlight — providing genuine blue light reduction without the colour temperature shift of software filters. Combined with hardware flicker-free technology, the LM27-E341AY eliminates imperceptible high-frequency backlight flickering that causes visual fatigue and headaches during extended gaming and creative sessions.
DUAL DisplayPort 1.4 + DUAL HDMI — QUAD-INPUT CONNECTIVITY
Four video inputs deliver maximum multi-source flexibility:
- 2x DisplayPort 1.4: Full 2560×1440 at 275Hz — for high-end gaming PCs and workstations
- 2x HDMI: High refresh rate QHD — for consoles, laptops, and secondary devices
Simultaneous quad-source connection enables full multi-device setups without cable swapping between sources.
TILT ADJUSTMENT & VESA 100x100mm MOUNT
The monitor stand supports tilt adjustment for comfortable viewing angle optimisation across desk heights and seating positions. The standard VESA 100x100mm mounting pattern accommodates any compatible monitor arm, wall bracket, or desk mount for placement flexibility beyond the included stand.
THREE-SIDED BORDERLESS DESIGN
The slim three-sided borderless bezel maximises screen presence within the monitor's physical footprint — delivering a cleaner, more immersive single-monitor experience and enabling tighter panel alignment in dual and multi-monitor configurations.

product_description:
The ASUS ROG Strix G16 (2025) in Eclipse Gray is a 2025-generation 16-inch gaming laptop built for enthusiast and competitive gamers who demand NVIDIA Blackwell-generation RTX 5060 performance, a 14th Generation Intel Core i7-14650HX processor, and a full suite of ROG's most advanced thermal, display, and connectivity technology — at the accessible entry point of the ROG Strix G16 lineup. With DLSS 4, Wi-Fi 7, Thunderbolt 4, a 90WHr battery, per-key RGB, and ROG's end-to-end vapor chamber cooling with liquid metal, the G16 (2025) delivers a hardware package that significantly outperforms its price tier.
NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 LAPTOP GPU — BLACKWELL, 8GB GDDR7, DLSS 4
The RTX 5060 Laptop GPU is powered by NVIDIA's Blackwell GPU architecture — the same generational leap from Ada Lovelace (RTX 40 series) that brought transformer-based neural rendering, fourth-generation Tensor Cores, and DLSS 4 to gaming laptops. With 8GB of GDDR7 VRAM on a 128-bit memory bus, the RTX 5060 delivers fast frame rates at 1920×1200 FHD+ in demanding AAA titles at high-to-ultra settings — handling games like Cyberpunk 2077, Black Myth: Wukong, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 with the visual fidelity and frame consistency the 165Hz display demands.
DLSS 4 — MULTI FRAME GENERATION + AI RENDERING
DLSS 4 (Deep Learning Super Sampling) is NVIDIA's fourth-generation AI-powered upscaling and frame generation technology, running on Blackwell's dedicated Tensor Cores. Multi Frame Generation — a DLSS 4 exclusive — generates up to three additional AI-rendered frames for every natively rendered frame, delivering frame rates that would otherwise require significantly more powerful hardware. At FHD+ on the ROG Strix G16's 165Hz display, DLSS 4 enables ultra-high frame rates in DLSS-supported titles with minimal perceptible quality loss — filling the 165Hz display with smooth, responsive frames that raw rasterisation alone cannot sustain in demanding scenes.
14TH GEN INTEL CORE i7-14650HX — 16 CORES, UP TO 5.2GHz
The Intel Core i7-14650HX is a 14th Generation Raptor Lake Refresh HX-series processor featuring 8 Performance cores (P-cores) running up to 5.2GHz and 8 Efficiency cores (E-cores) across 16 cores, 24 threads, and 30MB L3 cache. The HX platform's high-power CPU headroom feeds the RTX 5060 consistently under combined CPU-GPU gaming load — preventing CPU bottlenecking in frame-rate-sensitive competitive titles, open-world games, and streaming/gaming simultaneously.
16" FHD+ IPS 165Hz DISPLAY — 16:10, ACR FILM, 100% sRGB, 3ms
The 16-inch FHD+ (1920×1200) IPS display delivers the full ROG gaming display experience in the Strix G16's entry configuration:
- 165Hz refresh rate: smooth, responsive motion at full FHD+ resolution
- 3ms response time: fast pixel transitions with minimal ghosting at 165Hz
- 16:10 aspect ratio: 11% more vertical screen space than 16:9 — more content visible in-game, in browser, and in productivity applications
- 100% sRGB: accurate, vibrant colour reproduction across gaming and creative content
- ACR (Anti-glare Coating with Reflectance reduction) film: ASUS's advanced anti-glare treatment reduces glare and improves contrast over standard matte coatings
- 300 nits peak brightness: clear, well-exposed visuals in ambient lighting conditions
16GB DDR5 5600MHz — GAMING-OPTIMISED MEMORY
16GB of DDR5 5600MHz provides fast, gaming-optimised memory bandwidth for the RTX 5060 and i7-14650HX platform — handling all current AAA gaming workloads, simultaneous streaming, Discord, and browser sessions without memory pressure. DDR5 5600MHz's higher bandwidth over DDR4 directly benefits the RTX 5060's GPU-compute operations and reduces CPU memory latency under mixed gaming and application loads.
1TB PCIe Gen4 NVMe M.2 SSD — FAST GAME LOAD, LARGE LIBRARY
The 1TB PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD provides fast game install times, rapid level load, and quick asset streaming — with sequential read speeds up to 7,000MB/s depending on the installed drive — accommodating a substantial modern game library with room for the operating system and productivity applications. A second M.2 slot supports future storage expansion without replacing the primary drive.
ROG INTELLIGENT COOLING — VAPOR CHAMBER + TRI-FAN + LIQUID METAL
The ROG Strix G16 (2025) features ASUS's most advanced thermal system in the G16 line:
- End-to-end vapor chamber: a single continuous vapor chamber spans both CPU and GPU die areas simultaneously — distributing heat across the full heatsink surface more efficiently than heatpipe-only designs
- Tri-fan technology: three fans — two on the heatsink exits, one additional — maximise airflow volume and exhaust efficiency under sustained gaming load
- Conductonaut Extreme liquid metal: ASUS applies Conductonaut Extreme liquid metal thermal compound to both the CPU and GPU chipsets — providing lower thermal resistance than standard thermal paste, reducing peak die temperatures, and sustaining higher boost clocks for longer under gaming load
WI-FI 7 (802.11be) — NEXT-GENERATION WIRELESS GAMING
Intel Wi-Fi 7 BE200 (2x2, 802.11be) delivers the next generation of wireless gaming connectivity — with theoretical maximum throughput of 5.8Gbps, sub-2ms latency, and multi-link operation (MLO) that simultaneously uses 2.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands for maximum stability and minimum interference. For competitive online gaming, cloud streaming, and high-speed content downloads, Wi-Fi 7 provides a measurable networking advantage over Wi-Fi 6E systems. Bluetooth 5.4 supports simultaneous wireless peripheral connections with low latency.
THUNDERBOLT 4 DUAL USB-C — EGPU, 4K DISPLAY, HIGH-SPEED TRANSFER
The ROG Strix G16 features two Thunderbolt 4 USB-C ports — each supporting 40Gbps data transfer, DisplayPort 1.4 video output, Power Delivery charging, and G-Sync compatibility for external monitors. Thunderbolt 4's 40Gbps bandwidth enables external GPU enclosure connection, dual 4K monitor output, and NVMe SSD docking at full PCIe Gen3 ×4 speeds — making the G16 a genuine dual-purpose gaming and high-performance workstation platform.
PER-KEY RGB BACKLIT KEYBOARD
The full-size per-key RGB backlit keyboard supports ASUS Aura Sync for individually programmable key lighting across the full 16.8 million colour spectrum — enabling game-reactive lighting profiles, application-specific key highlighting, and custom aesthetic setups coordinated with compatible ROG peripherals.
DOLBY ATMOS — 2× 4W SPEAKER SYSTEM
Dual 4W speakers with Dolby Atmos processing deliver spatial audio with directional sound positioning for gaming, cinematic content, and video calls — producing richer, fuller audio from the built-in speaker system than standard gaming laptop audio implementations.
90WHr BATTERY — LARGEST IN CLASS
The 90WHr 4-cell battery is among the largest batteries available in a 16-inch gaming laptop — extending unplugged runtime for productivity, streaming, and light gaming sessions between charges. The ROG Strix G16 supports USB-C Power Delivery charging on both Thunderbolt 4 ports for flexible charging without the proprietary barrel connector.
COMPREHENSIVE CONNECTIVITY

product_description:
The OMEN by HP Obelisk gaming desktop features some significant changes to previous OMEN desktops with a more streamlined design and ergonomic improvements.
Read on to learn more about this awesome new gaming desktop by HP.
The OMEN Obelisk desktop is an easy-to-customize and powerful new gaming computer with top-notch specs and high-end components.
This gaming desktop features an optional tempered glass panel with interior RGB lighting that you can customize to your favorite color scheme.
Every configuration is equipped with high-performance HyperX® memory, demonstrating HP®’s commitment to performance for the gaming community.
The OMEN Obelisk offers a wide variety of configurations and supports industry-standard upgrades for internal components, including the motherboard. The chassis adheres to Micro-ATX standards, so if you want to swap out parts or upgrade over time, you can choose from a variety of off-the-shelf Micro-ATX motherboards.
Two 3.5-inch drive bays sit at the front of the chassis, and they have mounting holes for 2.5-inch drives in case you want to use some 2.5-inch solid state drives (SSDs). There are two M.2 slots included, with one full-length slot supporting storage and one half-length slot dedicated for the included WLAN module.
There is even enough space for industry-standard ATX power supplies, so if you want to upgrade to a 750W power supply, the chassis can handle it.
A few of the features of the OMEN Obelisk are built specifically for DIY gamers. For instance, you get tool-free access to the interior (and all the internal components) through a simple push-button latch at the back of the PC to open the side panel.
The 3.5-inch drive bays are also tool-free. Just squeeze the tabs on each side of the drives and pull. And to help reduce the frequency of maintenance, we offer an optional removable and easily-cleanable dust filter.
On the CPU side, the OMEN Obelisk desktop supports the latest architectures from Intel® and AMD®. You can configure up to a 6-core 8th Generation Intel Core i+ CPU (i7-8700+) or up to an 8-core 2nd Generation AMD Ryzen™ CPU (Ryzen 7 2700).
If you’re a gamer who is multi-tasking, live streaming, or doing desktop video editing, you’ll especially appreciate these high-core CPUs, which can handle heavily multi-threaded applications and hyper-threading.
The HP OMEN Obelisk offers up to 32GB HyperX® FURY DDR4-2666 memory as well as a variety of different storage configurations to help balance performance, capacity, and price point requirements.
In fact, you can configure up to three storage devices. There is space for one M.2 SSD (or Intel Optane™ module) and two 3.5-inch hard drives. As a result, available options include mixing PCIe® NVMe SSDs, a single hard drive, dual hard drives, or hard drives plus Intel Optane memory for storage acceleration.
The HP OMEN Obelisk offers the latest graphics architectures from NVIDIA with options up to GeForce® RTX 2080.
So you can enjoy:
All the high-performing hardware of the HP OMEN Obelisk desktop needs appropriate heat dissipation. That’s why it has extensive venting on the top, bottom, and sides of the chassis to help airflow and effectively manage heat.
You can see the triangular cut out pattern on both the top and bottom of the case, and the large vent on the side toward the front bezel. The power supply is also placed at the bottom of the case to help airflow and open options for future upgrades.
For gamers who like to experiment and want to upgrade the cooling solutions, there is an integrated mounting area for an additional aftermarket 120 mm fan or aftermarket 120 mm liquid-cooled radiator.

product_name: Logitech G PRO X 60 LIGHTSPEED Wireless Gaming Keyboard – White
product_description:
The Logitech G PRO X 60 LIGHTSPEED in White is Logitech G's first 60% pro gaming keyboard — engineered in collaboration with over 70 of the world's top esports athletes across 30+ prototypes and eight rounds of competitive testing. Combining LIGHTSPEED 2.4GHz wireless at 1ms response rate, Bluetooth multi-device connectivity, wired USB-C support, GX Tactile Optical switches, dual-shot PBT keycaps, KEYCONTROL 5-layer customisation, and LIGHTSYNC RGB — all in a compact 60% footprint with a included carrying case — the PRO X 60 LIGHTSPEED is the definitive tournament-ready compact wireless gaming keyboard.
60% FORM FACTOR — MAXIMUM MOUSE MOVEMENT SPACE
The 60% keyboard layout eliminates the numpad, function row, navigation cluster, and arrow keys — reducing the keyboard's physical footprint to just the core alphanumeric and modifier key zone. This directly extends the usable mousepad area to the left, allowing for larger, lower-sensitivity mouse movements that pro FPS, battle royale, and tactical shooter players demand at the highest competitive level. Compact control. Zero performance compromise.
GX TACTILE OPTICAL SWITCHES — ZERO DEBOUNCE, INSTANT ACTUATION
Your PRO X 60 ships with GX Tactile Optical switches — factory-lubricated optical switches that actuate through the power of light rather than physical contact, eliminating the debounce delay inherent in all mechanical switches. Actuation is instant the moment the light beam is broken — with a discernible tactile bump providing clear physical confirmation of each keypress without excessive noise or travel. Rated for over 50 million keystrokes per switch, the GX Optical delivers pro-grade durability alongside superior actuation consistency across the switch's full rated lifespan.
KEYCONTROL — 5-LAYER FULL KEYBOARD CUSTOMISATION
KEYCONTROL is Logitech G's pro-level key remapping system, accessible through Logitech G HUB software, that gives every key on the PRO X 60 up to five unique functions across five independently programmable layers. Layer activation can be assigned to any compatible Logitech G peripheral — including mice — allowing seamless in-game layer switching without reaching for the keyboard. Assign macros, shortcuts, DPI adjustments, media controls, and application-specific commands to any key on any layer — transforming the 60% layout's apparent limitation into a genuine competitive advantage.
LIGHTSPEED 2.4GHz WIRELESS — 1MS TOURNAMENT-GRADE RESPONSE
LIGHTSPEED 2.4GHz wireless delivers a 1ms report rate — the same wireless technology trusted by professional esports players at top-tier international tournaments. The included USB-A LIGHTSPEED adapter connects instantly, with no configuration required, and maintains a stable wireless signal even in RF-congested competitive arena environments.
BLUETOOTH MULTI-DEVICE — UP TO 3 DEVICES
Switch seamlessly to Bluetooth for wireless connectivity with laptops, tablets, smartphones, and non-USB devices. The PRO X 60 supports pairing to up to three Bluetooth devices simultaneously, with quick-switch capability between saved connections — making it a capable productivity keyboard as well as a gaming peripheral.
USB-C WIRED — CHARGING AND DATA
Connect via the included 1.8m USB-A to USB-C cable for a fully wired connection with zero latency and simultaneous charging — ideal for tournament play where wireless connectivity restrictions may apply, or for topping up the battery between sessions.
DUAL-SHOT PBT KEYCAPS — LEGENDS THAT LAST
The PRO X 60's keycaps are produced using the dual-shot injection moulding process — fusing two separate plastic layers to form legends that are physically part of the keycap structure, not printed or laser-etched on the surface. Dual-shot legends are physically impossible to fade or wear off through typing, regardless of usage intensity or duration. PBT plastic provides a firm, textured surface feel with greater resistance to shine and oils than standard ABS keycaps.
LIGHTSYNC RGB — PER-KEY CUSTOMISABLE BACKLIGHTING
Every key on the PRO X 60 is individually backlit with LIGHTSYNC RGB, fully customisable via Logitech G HUB. Assign static colours, animations, reactive effects, and game-integrated lighting profiles to individual keys or key zones. The RGB is visible through the dual-shot PBT legends for consistent, even illumination without hotspot bleed.
GAME MODE, VOLUME ROLLER & MEDIA CONTROLS
The keyboard sides feature a dedicated game mode toggle (disabling the Windows key during gameplay), a physical volume roller for instant audio control, and media playback controls — accessible without layer switching, without removing your hand from the mouse.
65-HOUR BATTERY LIFE — USB-C RECHARGEABLE
A single full charge delivers up to 65 hours of wireless operation — enough for multiple full gaming weeks between charges under typical usage. USB-C charging is compatible with standard smartphone cables.
CARRYING CASE INCLUDED
A protective hard carrying case is included in the box — specifically designed to protect the PRO X 60 in transit to LAN events, tournaments, and gaming sessions outside the home. The carrying case also accommodates the LIGHTSPEED receiver and charging cable.

LOGITECH G LIGHTSPEED 2.4GHz WIRELESS — LOW-LATENCY PC GAMING
The G321 is powered by Logitech G's proprietary LIGHTSPEED 2.4GHz wireless technology — the same platform used in Logitech G's professional and enthusiast gaming headset lineup. The included USB-A LIGHTSPEED receiver delivers a rock-solid, lag-free wireless connection up to 10 metres from your PC or PlayStation, with zero perceptible audio latency during gameplay. Simply plug in the receiver, power on the headset, and play — no software, no pairing process, no configuration required.
BLUETOOTH 5.2 — MOBILE, DISCORD & MULTIPLATFORM
Switch to Bluetooth 5.2 for wireless connectivity with smartphones, tablets, laptops, Nintendo Switch, and any other Bluetooth-enabled device — making the G321 equally capable as a gaming headset and a daily wireless headset for music, calls, and Discord chat. A dedicated Bluetooth button on the earcup initiates pairing and switches between connections with a single press.
40MM HIGH-PERFORMANCE AUDIO DRIVERS
The G321's 40mm dynamic audio drivers cover the full 20Hz–20,000Hz frequency range, delivering rich, spacious sound with a powerful bass response — producing satisfying impact on explosions, environmental ambience, and cinematic soundscapes. Positional audio cues, directional sound, and distance detection are reproduced accurately — giving competitive gamers the audio awareness needed in tactical and shooter titles.
16KHZ FLIP-TO-MUTE OMNIDIRECTIONAL BOOM MICROPHONE
The integrated omnidirectional boom microphone samples at up to 16-bit/16kHz — delivering clear, detailed voice communication for team chat, Discord, and online calls. Flipping the mic arm upward mutes the microphone instantly and automatically — no button press required. Flipping it back down reactivates communication immediately, keeping gameplay uninterrupted.
ENGINEERED FOR ALL-DAY COMFORT — 210G LIGHTWEIGHT DESIGN
At just 210 grams, the G321 LIGHTSPEED is one of the lightest wireless gaming headsets in its class. The 15mm thick headband padding, 21mm deep memory foam ear cushions, and high-elasticity knit fabric covering are specifically engineered to distribute weight evenly, reduce pressure points, and maintain breathability across extended gaming and work sessions — making the G321 genuinely wearable for full workday and evening gaming combinations without fatigue.
SIMPLE ON-HEADSET CONTROLS
Power, Bluetooth, and volume controls are positioned directly on the earcup for instant access without removing the headset or navigating software menus — keeping you focused on gameplay during critical sessions.
20+ HOUR BATTERY LIFE — USB-C CHARGING
A single full charge via USB-C delivers 20+ hours of continuous wireless audio at 78dB SPL — enough for multiple full gaming sessions between charges. USB-C charging means the G321 shares a cable with modern smartphones, laptops, and controllers, reducing cable clutter.
WHITE COLOURWAY — TURQUOISE ACCENT DESIGN
The White G321 features a clean white finish with distinctive turquoise accent details — a modern, understated aesthetic that complements PS5 setups, white desk builds, and Studio-series peripheral ecosystems without the aggressive "gamer" styling of competing headsets.
PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY
Connects via LIGHTSPEED USB receiver to PC (Windows) and PlayStation 4/5. Connects via Bluetooth 5.2 to Nintendo Switch, Mac, mobile devices, and any Bluetooth audio source. Note: Xbox requires wired connection (3.5mm aux cable, not included) — not officially listed as Xbox-compatible via LIGHTSPEED or Bluetooth in this SKU.

product_name: Logitech G PRO X 60 LIGHTSPEED Wireless Gaming Keyboard – Magenta
product_description:
The Logitech G PRO X 60 LIGHTSPEED in Magenta is Logitech G's first 60% pro gaming keyboard — engineered with input from over 70 of the world's top esports athletes across 30+ prototypes and eight rounds of competitive testing. Combining LIGHTSPEED 2.4GHz wireless at 1ms response rate, Bluetooth multi-device connectivity, wired USB-C support, GX Tactile Optical switches, dual-shot PBT keycaps, KEYCONTROL 5-layer customisation, and LIGHTSYNC RGB — all in a compact 60% footprint with an included hard carrying case — the PRO X 60 LIGHTSPEED Magenta delivers tournament-ready performance in the most distinctive colourway in the lineup.
60% FORM FACTOR — MAXIMUM MOUSE MOVEMENT SPACE
The 60% layout eliminates the numpad, function row, navigation cluster, and arrow keys — reducing the keyboard's footprint to just the core alphanumeric and modifier zone. The freed desk space directly extends usable mousepad area, enabling the large, low-sensitivity mouse arcs demanded by pro-level FPS, battle royale, and tactical shooter players. The Magenta colourway pairs the 60% form factor's clean minimalism with a bold visual identity that sets it apart from the standard Black and White variants.
GX TACTILE OPTICAL SWITCHES — ZERO DEBOUNCE, INSTANT ACTUATION
The PRO X 60 Magenta ships with GX Tactile Optical switches — factory-lubricated optical switches that actuate through the interruption of a light beam rather than physical contact, eliminating the debounce delay present in all mechanical switches. A discernible tactile bump provides clear keystroke confirmation with controlled noise levels — the preferred switch profile for competitive FPS and tactical gaming. Rated for over 50 million keystrokes per switch with no degradation of actuation consistency over the switch's full rated lifespan.
KEYCONTROL — 5-LAYER FULL KEYBOARD CUSTOMISATION
KEYCONTROL gives every key on the PRO X 60 up to five unique functions across five independently programmable layers, managed through Logitech G HUB. Layer activation can be mapped to any compatible Logitech G peripheral — including mice — enabling in-game layer switching without lifting the hand from the mouse. Assign macros, shortcuts, media controls, DPI commands, and application-specific bindings to any key across any layer — turning the 60% layout's reduced key count into a genuine competitive asset.
LIGHTSPEED 2.4GHz WIRELESS — 1MS TOURNAMENT-GRADE RESPONSE
LIGHTSPEED 2.4GHz wireless delivers a 1ms report rate — the same wireless platform trusted by professional esports players at the highest international competitive level. The included USB-A LIGHTSPEED adapter connects instantly with no configuration, maintaining a stable, interference-resistant signal even in RF-dense tournament environments.
BLUETOOTH MULTI-DEVICE — UP TO 3 DEVICES
Pair to up to three Bluetooth devices simultaneously for seamless switching between a gaming PC, laptop, tablet, or smartphone — extending the PRO X 60's utility beyond gaming into a full-day productivity keyboard. No additional receiver required for Bluetooth-connected devices.
USB-C WIRED — ZERO LATENCY & SIMULTANEOUS CHARGING
The included 1.8m USB-A to USB-C cable enables a fully wired connection with zero wireless latency and simultaneous battery charging — suitable for tournament environments with wireless restrictions or for maintaining full battery during marathon sessions.
DUAL-SHOT PBT KEYCAPS — LEGENDS THAT NEVER FADE
Dual-shot injection moulding fuses two separate plastic layers to create legends that are structurally part of the keycap — not printed, laser-etched, or pad-printed on the surface. Dual-shot legends cannot fade, wear, or peel regardless of typing intensity or session duration. PBT plastic delivers a firm, textured surface feel with superior resistance to shine and finger oils compared to standard ABS keycaps. The Magenta edition's keycap colourway is consistent across the entire key surface for a bold, cohesive desk aesthetic.
LIGHTSYNC RGB — PER-KEY CUSTOMISABLE BACKLIGHTING
Every key on the PRO X 60 is individually backlit with LIGHTSYNC RGB, fully programmable via Logitech G HUB. Assign static colours, animations, reactive lighting effects, or game-integrated profiles to individual keys or key zones. RGB illumination passes through the dual-shot PBT legends for consistent, even per-key lighting without surface hotspots.
GAME MODE, VOLUME ROLLER & MEDIA CONTROLS
On-keyboard side controls include a game mode toggle (disabling the Windows key during gameplay), a physical volume roller, and media playback controls — all accessible without layer switching and without removing your hand from the mouse during gameplay.
65-HOUR BATTERY LIFE — USB-C RECHARGEABLE
Up to 65 hours of wireless operation per charge — covering multiple full gaming weeks between recharges under typical usage. USB-C charging is compatible with standard smartphone and laptop cables.
CARRYING CASE INCLUDED
A dedicated hard carrying case is included in the box — protecting the PRO X 60 during transit to LAN events, tournaments, or gaming sessions away from home. Accommodates the keyboard, LIGHTSPEED receiver, and charging cable.

product_name: Logitech Desk Mat Studio Series – Mid Grey
product_description:
The Logitech Desk Mat Studio Series in Mid Grey is a premium extended desk pad engineered to elevate the look, comfort, and functionality of any workspace. Built from sustainably sourced recycled materials with a spill-resistant surface, anti-fray flat-stitched edges, and a natural rubber anti-slip base, it delivers the desk protection and effortless mouse glide that professionals, creatives, and home-office users demand — in a versatile, understated Mid Grey colourway that complements any setup.
EXTENDED XXL COVERAGE — 700 x 300mm
At 700mm wide and 300mm deep, the Desk Mat Studio Series provides a full-coverage workspace surface large enough to comfortably accommodate a full-size keyboard, mouse, notebook, and additional accessories side by side — eliminating the need for a separate mousepad and keyboard mat.
EFFORTLESS SILENT MOUSE GLIDE
The fine-weave cloth surface is engineered for smooth, silent, friction-free mouse tracking across its entire surface. Whether you use an optical, laser, or trackball mouse, the Desk Mat delivers consistent, responsive glide with zero surface drag — eliminating the scratching and inconsistency of hard desk surfaces.
SPILL-RESISTANT SURFACE — WIPES CLEAN INSTANTLY
The surface features a spill-repellent coating that causes liquids to bead on contact rather than absorb — protecting the mat and your desk from accidental coffee spills, water, and everyday mishaps. Clean-up requires nothing more than a damp cloth. No soaking, no drying time, back in use immediately.
ANTI-FRAY FLAT-STITCHED EDGES
The perimeter of the Desk Mat is finished with precision flat-stitching in a nylon and polyester blend — engineered to resist fraying and edge separation across years of daily use. No peeling, no unravelling, no degradation of the mat edge over time.
NATURAL RUBBER ANTI-SLIP BASE
The underside features a 72% natural rubber anti-slip base that grips firmly to any desk surface — hardwood, glass, laminate, or fabric — keeping the mat perfectly positioned under active keyboard and mouse use without creeping or bunching.
WRINKLE & SHRINK-RESISTANT CONSTRUCTION
The strong, soft surface fibres are wrinkle and shrink-resistant by design — the Desk Mat lies perfectly flat from first use and maintains its shape and surface integrity through years of daily use without curling at the edges or developing surface impressions.
SUSTAINABLE MATERIALS THROUGHOUT
The surface fabric and inner layer are constructed from 100% recycled polyester — repurposing post-consumer PET bottles into premium desk mat material. The anti-slip base uses 72% natural rubber. The Desk Mat Studio Series is a Logitech commitment to responsible material sourcing without compromise on performance or aesthetics.
PAIRS WITH THE LOGITECH STUDIO & POP ECOSYSTEM
The Mid Grey colourway is designed to complement Logitech's Studio Series and POP product lines — including the POP Keys mechanical keyboard, POP Mouse, Pebble Mouse 2, K380 multi-device keyboard, and ERGO M575S trackball — creating a cohesive, curated desk aesthetic.

Experience incredible 7.1 surround sound with DTS Headphone:X Surround Sound, creating precise and accurate in-game spatial awareness, allowing you to clearly hear enemies sneaking around or special ability cues. Customize each directional channel using Logitech G HUB. You can even program different sound profiles for each game. You’ll need to connect to your PC through the included USB digital audio converter (DAC) to activate DTS Headphone:X.1Virtual 7.1 Surround only on PC and requires use of USB wireless. Stereo on consoles, smartphones and tablets using 3.5 mm analog output. Some console controllers require an adapter for audio cable input.
Pro-G drivers produce booming bass and clear highs thanks to hybrid-mesh construction that drastically reduce distortion. G433 ear cups also feature an acoustic port positioned behind the driver for even more dynamic, spatial sound.
Weighing in at 259 g, G433 is comprised of lightweight, glass-fiber injected polycarbonate, stainless steel and TR-90 nylon. Featuring sports-mesh ear pads that surround the ear and provide just the right amount of force to stay firmly in place and comfortably breathable. Bonus extra-soft microfiber ear pads are also included for your choice in style and comfort.
The noise-cancelling boom microphone with micro-pop filter is designed for clarity in communications and chat. G433 is Discord certified guaranteeing crystal-clear communication performance.
Works with PC, PS4®, Xbox® One, Nintendo® Switch™, smartphones and tablets. G433 comes with two separate audio cables to optimally connect and perform on essentially all gaming devices.2Virtual 7.1 Surround only on PC and requires use of USB wireless. Stereo on consoles, smartphones and tablets using 3.5 mm analog output. Some console controllers require an adapter for audio cable input.
G433 comes fully equipped and fully modular. The detachable boom mic and swappable cables quickly transform G433 from PC/console mode to mobile/on-the-move mode. This is an agile headset that games wherever life takes you.
Harness the power of Artificial Intelligence to deliver truly immersive sound experiences uniquely crafted for your ears. With Immerse, you hear the precise location of enemy footsteps and reload sounds; you have the advantage of hearing your enemies before they hear you. The Close Combat feature brings you right into the action as you feel bullets whiz by. Bring the power of Immerse to your Logitech G headset and turn your ears into lethal weapons.

product_name: Logitech G513 Lightsync Usb-N/A-Intnl-Clicky Gaming Keyboard
product_description:
G513 is a high-performance gaming keyboard featuring your choice of advanced GX mechanical switches. The detachable, memory-foam palmrest and premium aluminum-alloy construction make G513 full-featured and best-in-class.
G513 can be customizable per key with approximate 16.8 M colors. Create your own animations or choose from a selection of preset effects. And with LIGHTSYNC technology, lighting is driven by games, audio, or your screen to deliver the most immersive RGB experience ever.Advanced settings require Logitech G HUB available for download at logitech.com/downloads
Advanced GX mechanical switches—engineered and 100% tested for performance, responsiveness, and durability. Choose from three distinct mechanical switches- GX Blue (Clicky), GX Brown (Tactile), GX Red (Linear).
The memory foam quickly and fully recovers from pressure, so every use is as comfortable as the first. Soft, strong and durable leatherette wraps the comfort foam in a waterproof and sweat-resistant material that easily wipes clean. Six bottom-mounted rubber feet keep it firmly in place. This palmrest is ready to game.
G513 is crafted from incredibly strong and durable 5052 aluminum-magnesium alloy which allows for both a minimal design and a beautiful aesthetic. The rigidity of 5052 alloy also provides a sturdy, non-slip chassis that houses a full suite of features for an unbeatable gaming experience.
Convenience and speed are directly within reach. The additional, dedicated USB cable connects the USB passthrough port to its own input for full power throughput and data speed. Plug in a device to charge or plug in a mouse to charge your adversaries, without missing a beat.
Media and lighting controls are right at your fingertips. Use the FN key to control volume, play and pause, mute, toggle game mode, change lighting effects, etc. Use the FN toggle feature in Logitech G HUB and configure your function keys to perform these alt commands by default.

product_name: Logitech G502 Hero High Performance Gaming Mouse
product_description:
G502 HERO features an advanced optical sensor for maximum tracking accuracy, customizable RGB lighting, custom game profiles, from 200 up to 25,600 DPI, and repositionable weights.
HERO 25K is our most accurate gaming sensor ever with next-gen precision and a ground-up architecture. With the fastest frame rate processing yet, HERO is capable of 400+ IPS across the 100 - 25,600 DPI range with zero smoothing, filtering or acceleration. HERO 25K achieves competition-level precision and the most consistent responsiveness ever. Be sure to customize and tune your DPI settings using Logitech G HUB.
Use Logitech G HUB to program your favorite commands and macros to each of the 11 buttons. Build, crouch, melee, heal … put your power moves at your fingertips. Save ready-to-play profiles directly to the mouse to take your settings with you anywhere.
Fine tune mouse feel and glide to your advantage. Five 3.6g weights come with G502 HERO and are configurable in a variety of front, rear, left, right and center weighted configurations. Experiment with the alignment and balance to find the sweet spot to optimize your gaming performance.
LIGHTSYNC technology is next generation RGB that can be driven by games, audio, or your screen to deliver the most immersive RGB experience ever. Select from a full spectrum of approximately 16.8 million colors and synchronize lighting animations and effects with your other Logitech G devices. Customize it all quickly and easily using Logitech G HUB.
In addition to the core performance and personalization features, many details were thoughtfully engineered and designed. Look for primary buttons with mechanical switches, rubberized side grips, magnetic weight-cavity door, and more.

product_description:
The ASUS VivoBook 15 X1504 in Cool Silver is a slim, lightweight everyday laptop engineered for students, home users, and light-use professionals who need a reliable, capable machine for studying, browsing, streaming, video calls, and productivity — with a premium set of usability features rarely found at this price point. Powered by the Intel Core 5 120U processor with Intel Iris Xe Graphics, 8GB DDR4 RAM, and a 512GB PCIe NVMe SSD, the VivoBook 15 delivers smooth, responsive everyday performance in a 1.70 kg chassis with a backlit keyboard, fingerprint reader, 180° lay-flat hinge, and physical webcam privacy shutter.
INTEL CORE 5 120U — 10 CORES, UP TO 5.0GHz
The Intel Core 5 120U is a 15th-generation Intel processor built on the hybrid core architecture — combining 2 Performance cores (P-cores) boosting to 5.0GHz and 8 Efficiency cores (E-cores) across 10 cores and 12 threads, with 12MB L3 cache and a 15W TDP. The high E-core count enables true background task parallelism — managing system updates, cloud sync, antivirus scanning, and media playback simultaneously while P-cores remain fully available for active foreground tasks. Intel Thread Director allocates workloads dynamically between core types for smooth, responsive performance throughout the day.
INTEL IRIS XE GRAPHICS — BEYOND STANDARD INTEGRATED
The Core 5 120U integrates Intel Iris Xe Graphics — a dedicated integrated GPU architecture that handles smooth 4K video playback, accelerated display rendering, casual gaming at 1080p, photo editing in standard creative applications, and external display output via HDMI and USB-C with DisplayPort. Iris Xe provides a noticeably more capable integrated graphics experience than previous-generation Intel UHD Graphics at equivalent price points.
15.6" FHD IPS NANOEDGE DISPLAY — ANTI-GLARE, 84% SCREEN-TO-BODY RATIO
The 15.6-inch Full HD (1920×1080) IPS NanoEdge display delivers clear, sharp visuals at 141 PPI with wide 178° viewing angles — ensuring consistent colour accuracy from any seating position. The slim NanoEdge bezel achieves an 84% screen-to-body ratio, maximising the visible display area within the VivoBook's compact chassis. The anti-glare coating minimises reflections during use in brightly lit home and office environments, and the 250 nits brightness maintains comfortable viewing in standard indoor ambient lighting.
8GB DDR4 RAM — SMOOTH EVERYDAY PERFORMANCE
8GB DDR4 3200MHz RAM handles the full range of standard everyday computing workloads — web browsing with multiple tabs, Microsoft 365, video streaming, video calls, and productivity applications — concurrently without performance degradation. Sufficient for the complete breadth of home, educational, and light-office computing tasks.
512GB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD — FAST, RESPONSIVE STORAGE
The 512GB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD delivers fast Windows boot times, quick application launches, and rapid file access — keeping the VivoBook 15 feeling responsive throughout the day. PCIe NVMe speeds are significantly faster than SATA SSD alternatives, reducing load times across all storage-intensive operations. 512GB provides ample capacity for operating system, applications, documents, photos, and media.
ERGOSENSE BACKLIT KEYBOARD WITH NUMPAD
The full-size ErgoSense chiclet keyboard is designed for comfortable extended typing with optimised key pitch, travel, and spacing — reducing typing fatigue during long study and work sessions. Backlit keys illuminate for comfortable typing in low-light and dim environments, and the integrated numeric keypad enables fast data entry for spreadsheets, financial tasks, and numerical input without an external numpad.
FINGERPRINT READER — WINDOWS HELLO
The integrated fingerprint reader on the touchpad enables instant, passwordless Windows Hello biometric login — a single touch replaces manual password entry for faster, more secure daily access.
180° LAY-FLAT HINGE — FLEXIBLE COLLABORATION
The VivoBook 15's 180° lay-flat hinge allows the display to open fully flat — enabling side-by-side collaborative viewing, screen sharing, and flexible working positions that standard laptops cannot accommodate. The hinge also supports one-handed lid opening for convenient single-handed setup.
PHYSICAL WEBCAM PRIVACY SHUTTER
The 720p HD webcam features a physical slide-to-close privacy shutter — mechanically blocking the camera lens when not in use, independent of any software setting. Essential for students in shared accommodation, professionals in video-call-heavy environments, and privacy-conscious users.
ASUS ANTIMICROBIAL GUARD PLUS
The VivoBook 15's frequently-touched surfaces — keyboard, touchpad, and palm rest — are treated with ASUS Antimicrobial Guard Plus, a built-in protective coating that inhibits the growth of harmful bacteria on contact surfaces throughout the laptop's lifespan.
WI-FI 6 + BLUETOOTH 5.2
Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax, 1x1) delivers fast, reliable wireless connectivity for video streaming, video calls, cloud-based productivity, and large file downloads on compatible Wi-Fi 6 routers. Bluetooth 5.2 connects wireless peripherals, headphones, and mobile devices with stable, low-latency connections.
UP TO 7-HOUR BATTERY LIFE — 42WHr
The 42WHr 3-cell battery provides up to 7 hours of real-world battery life under mixed everyday workloads — sufficient for a full school day, study session, or working day away from a power outlet.

product_name: Lenovo V14 G4 IRU – 13th Gen Intel Core i7-13620H – Business Laptop
product_description:
The Lenovo V14 G4 IRU is a compact, MIL-SPEC rated 14-inch business laptop engineered for professionals, students, and home-office users who need a reliable, high-performance daily machine with enterprise-grade durability, comprehensive security, and all-day battery life — in one of the lightest 14-inch business laptops available at 1.43 kg. Powered by the 13th Generation Intel Core i7-13620H H-series processor with 10 cores and up to 4.9GHz boost, 16GB DDR4 RAM, and a 512GB PCIe NVMe SSD — the V14 G4 delivers H-series workstation performance in a portable business form factor.
13TH GEN INTEL CORE i7-13620H — H-SERIES, 10 CORES, UP TO 4.9GHz
The Intel Core i7-13620H is a 13th Generation Raptor Lake H-series processor — a fundamental step up from U-series processors found in most 14-inch laptops at this price point. With 6 Performance cores (P-cores) boosting to 4.9GHz and 4 Efficiency cores (E-cores) across 10 cores and 16 threads, 24MB L3 cache, and a 45W TDP — the i7-13620H delivers significantly higher sustained performance under multithreaded load compared to equivalent U-series i7 processors. Demanding workloads — large spreadsheets, complex data models, video encoding, multi-application workflows, and simultaneous cloud sync — are handled with the raw processing headroom that 45W H-series silicon provides.
H-SERIES VS U-SERIES — WHY IT MATTERS
Most 14-inch laptops at this price tier ship with 15W U-series processors (i7-1355U, i7-1165G7). The i7-13620H's 45W TDP provides up to 3x the sustained power budget under sustained load — translating to measurably faster completion times on CPU-intensive tasks, more stable performance under prolonged workloads, and greater headroom for simultaneous multitasking without thermal throttling. For buyers comparing this against standard business 14-inch configurations, the i7-13620H is the primary performance differentiator.
16GB DDR4 3200MHz — SMOOTH MULTITASKING
16GB DDR4 3200MHz RAM provides ample memory headroom for concurrent multi-application workflows — Microsoft 365, browser sessions, video conferencing, ERP/CRM tools, and background processes — running simultaneously without slowdowns or memory pressure. Sufficient for the full breadth of professional, educational, and home-office computing workloads.
512GB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD — FAST BOOT & RESPONSIVE STORAGE
The 512GB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD delivers fast boot times, rapid application launches, and quick file access — keeping the V14 G4 responsive throughout the working day without the wait associated with SATA or HDD storage. An available M.2 slot allows future storage expansion for users who anticipate growing storage needs.
14" FHD ANTI-GLARE DISPLAY — 1920×1080, 250 NITS
The 14-inch Full HD (1920×1080) anti-glare display delivers clear, sharp visuals at 157 PPI with a 250 nits brightness level suited to standard indoor office and home environments. The TÜV Rheinland Low Blue Light certification independently validates the display's blue light reduction capability — protecting eye comfort during extended working sessions without requiring manual software filter adjustment. The compact 14-inch form factor keeps the V14 G4 portable and desk-efficient for on-the-go and tight-workspace use.
MIL-STD-810H MILITARY-GRADE DURABILITY
The Lenovo V14 G4 is tested and certified to MIL-STD-810H standards — a US Department of Defense durability test protocol covering resistance to temperature extremes, altitude, humidity, vibration, shock, dust, and drop stress. MIL-810H certification provides confidence in real-world reliability across business travel, commuting, field work, and the daily rigours of professional use that consumer laptops are not engineered to withstand.
DOLBY AUDIO — DUAL SPEAKERS + NOISE-CANCELLING MICROPHONE
Dolby Audio processing enhances the V14 G4's dual 1.5W stereo speaker output with dynamic equalisation and spatial audio optimisation — delivering richer, fuller audio for video conferencing, media playback, and content consumption. Dual-array noise-cancelling microphones filter ambient background noise from video call audio — ensuring clear voice transmission in open-plan offices, shared workspaces, and home environments without an external headset.
HD WEBCAM WITH INTEGRATED PRIVACY SHUTTER
The 720p HD webcam delivers clear video for Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, and video calls in standard lighting conditions. The integrated physical privacy shutter mechanically blocks the camera lens when not in use — providing a hardware-level privacy guarantee for sensitive business environments and data-conscious users.
ENTERPRISE-GRADE SECURITY

WI-FI 6 + BLUETOOTH 5.2 — FAST, RELIABLE WIRELESS
Realtek Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax, 2x2, MU-MIMO) delivers fast, stable wireless connectivity with up to 3x the throughput of Wi-Fi 5 in congested multi-device environments. Bluetooth 5.2 maintains reliable, low-latency connections to wireless peripherals, headsets, and mobile devices simultaneously.

product_name: Dell Inspiron 15 3530 – 13th Gen Intel Core i7-1355U – Laptop
product_description:
The Dell Inspiron 15 3530 is a premium consumer laptop engineered for students, professionals, content creators, and everyday power users who demand a fast, responsive, visually capable machine for productivity, creative work, entertainment, and light gaming. Featuring a 13th Generation Intel Core i7-1355U processor, a 120Hz Full HD WVA display, Intel Iris Xe integrated graphics, 16GB DDR4 3200MHz RAM in dual-channel configuration, a 1TB PCIe NVMe SSD, Wi-Fi 6, a 1080p FHD webcam, and Waves MaxxAudio Pro — the Inspiron 3530 i7 delivers a significantly more capable experience than standard 60Hz Intel UHD configurations at the same price tier.
13TH GEN INTEL CORE i7-1355U — 10 CORES, UP TO 5.0GHz
The Intel Core i7-1355U is a 13th Generation Raptor Lake hybrid processor combining 2 Performance cores (P-cores) boosting to 5.0GHz and 8 Efficiency cores (E-cores) across 10 cores and 12 threads, with 12MB L3 cache and a 15W base TDP. P-cores handle demanding tasks at maximum clock speed — browser-heavy multitasking, Microsoft 365 workflows, video calls, photo editing, and content creation — while E-cores manage background processes in parallel without thermal penalty. Intel Thread Director allocates tasks dynamically between core types for simultaneous performance and power efficiency throughout the day.
INTEL IRIS XE GRAPHICS — BEYOND STANDARD INTEGRATED
Unlike standard Intel UHD Graphics found in entry and business configurations, Intel Iris Xe is a dedicated integrated GPU architecture with significantly more execution units, higher clock speeds, and substantially greater graphics performance. Iris Xe handles smooth 4K video playback, accelerated photo and video editing in Adobe Lightroom and Premiere, light gaming at 1080p, and dual external 4K display output via HDMI 1.4 and USB-C with DisplayPort Alt Mode — tasks that Intel UHD struggles to perform without frame drops or stuttering.
120Hz FHD WVA DISPLAY — SMOOTH, RESPONSIVE, COMFORTABLE
The 15.6-inch Full HD (1920×1080) WVA anti-glare display runs at 120Hz — double the refresh rate of standard 60Hz laptop panels. At 120Hz, cursor movement, window animations, scrolling, video playback, and light gaming all appear dramatically smoother and more fluid — a perceptible, immediate quality difference that becomes impossible to ignore after daily use. The WVA panel technology delivers wide viewing angles with consistent colour accuracy, and the 250 nits anti-glare coating minimises reflections during extended outdoor and office use. Dell ComfortView blue light reduction is integrated for eye fatigue management during long sessions.
16GB DDR4 3200MHz DUAL-CHANNEL — MAXIMUM INTEGRATED GPU PERFORMANCE
This configuration ships with 16GB DDR4 3200MHz RAM in a 2×8GB dual-channel configuration — a critical advantage over single-channel 8GB or 16GB configurations. Intel Iris Xe Graphics accesses system RAM as video memory, and dual-channel bandwidth directly doubles the available memory bandwidth to the GPU — producing measurably higher frame rates in gaming, faster render times in creative applications, and smoother performance across all GPU-accelerated workloads. 16GB total capacity also ensures smooth simultaneous multitasking across demanding multi-application workflows.
1TB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD — DOUBLE THE STORAGE, FULL NVMe SPEED
The 1TB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD provides double the storage capacity of standard 512GB configurations — accommodating operating system, full application suites, large creative project files, game libraries, and extensive media collections without immediate expansion requirements. NVMe sequential read speeds reduce Windows boot to under 15 seconds, large application launch to seconds, and project file load times to near-instant — transforming the overall system responsiveness compared to SATA SSD alternatives.
WI-FI 6 (802.11ax) — FASTER, MORE STABLE WIRELESS
The Realtek Wi-Fi 6 (RTL8852BE, 2x2, 802.11ax, 160MHz channel, MU-MIMO) delivers up to 3x the throughput of Wi-Fi 5 in real-world multi-device home and office environments. The 160MHz channel width maximises transfer speed on Wi-Fi 6 compatible routers, while MU-MIMO maintains stable connection quality when multiple devices share the access point simultaneously — critical for smooth video conferencing, cloud collaboration, and 4K streaming.
FHD 1080p WEBCAM WITH TEMPORAL NOISE REDUCTION
The integrated Full HD 1080p webcam delivers sharp, detailed video in Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, and video calls — a step up from the 720p HD webcam found in the Vostro 3530 and budget configurations. Temporal Noise Reduction (TNR) processing reduces video grain in low-light conditions, maintaining clearer facial detail during indoor and dimly lit video calls.
WAVES MAXHAUDIO PRO — PREMIUM AUDIO PROCESSING
Waves MaxxAudio Pro is a professional-grade audio processing suite that enhances the Inspiron 3530's stereo speaker output with dynamic equalization, bass enhancement, and spatial audio effects — delivering significantly richer, fuller sound from the built-in speakers than standard audio implementations at the same price tier.
EXPRESSCHARGE — 80% IN ONE HOUR
Dell ExpressCharge charges the 3-cell 41WHr battery to 80% capacity in approximately one hour from depleted — minimising time at the charger between sessions.
COMPREHENSIVE CONNECTIVITY
- 1x USB-A 2.0
- 2x USB-A 3.2 Gen 1 (5Gbps)
- 1x USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 (5Gbps, DisplayPort Alt Mode + Power Delivery)

The Lenovo IdeaPad 5 2-in-1 14IRU9 Flip (2025) is a versatile convertible laptop designed for productivity and flexibility. It is powered by the Intel® Core™ 5 120U processor, which features 10 cores (2 performance and 8 efficiency cores) and 12 threads. The processor offers a base frequency of 1.4 GHz and can boost up to 5.0 GHz, ensuring smooth multitasking and responsive performance.
The device has 8GB of soldered LPDDR5-5200 RAM and a 512GB M.2 2242 PCIe® 4.0x4 NVMe SSD, providing ample memory and fast storage solutions. Its 14.0-inch WUXGA (1920x1200) IPS touchscreen delivers vibrant visuals with 300 nits brightness and supports multi-touch functionality, making it ideal for both work and entertainment.
Additional features include integrated Intel® Graphics, a touch-style fingerprint reader on the palm rest for enhanced security, and a durable design with an aluminum top cover and PC-ABS bottom. The laptop also supports a 360-degree hinge, allowing it to be used in various modes such as laptop, tent, stand, or tablet
Multitask at High Speed
Maximize every moment with the power of Intel® Core™ processors building a portfolio, mastering a new skill, or expressing your creativity, the IdeaPad 5i 2-in-1 laptop has got you covered. With plenty of memory, it delivers unparalleled performance, so all your apps and programs run smoothly and seamlessly. Also, from important work documents to treasured photos and videos, the huge storage capacity ensures you will never have to worry about running out of space.
Unlock a World of Possibilities
Perfect for any task at hand, the 14-inch IdeaPad 5i 2-in-1 laptop knows no bounds. Its 360° hinge allows for endless possibilities, unrivaled flexibility, and four different use modes. You can knock out a business plan in laptop mode, stream the latest episode in tent mode, present confidently in stand mode, or get creative with sketching on tablet mode. It is built with a sleek metal cover, available in two eye-catching shades: Luna Grey and Cosmic Blue.
A True Cinematic Masterpiece
With its stunning colors and cinematic quality on a taller touchscreen display, the IdeaPad 5i 2-in-1 laptop brings your content to life with detailed clarity. Work for extended periods without straining your eyes, thanks to TÜV Low Blue Light certification. Plus, the impressive sound quality of Dolby Audio™-certified speakers lets you unwind and listen to your favorite music — every note and beat is precise, and deep, transporting you to another world of pure bliss.
Powerful Productivity-Based Features
Enjoy effortless access to your IdeaPad 5i 2-in-1 laptop, thanks to secure login using the fingerprint sensor. Work for hours without the need to stop and recharge given the long battery life. Whether you need to quickly jot down ideas or add a personal touch to your work, the optional Lenovo Digital Pen takes your creativity to the next level. With full-function ports, you can connect to multiple devices, so your workday gets more efficient. And if you want total control of your webcam, the built-in privacy shutter does the job for you.
Toughness Redefined with Elegance
The IdeaPad 5i 2-in-1 laptop is tough enough for all your journeys. Carry it along with you to a café, boardroom, or anywhere without worry, as the machine meets the rigorous durability standards of MIL-STD-810H. Whether you tuck the device in your backpack or work on a project sitting at a beachside, the military-grade toughness permits it to handle extreme temperatures, altitudes, humidity, vibration, sudden shocks, and drops.
Stay Connected Without Hitches
Keep in touch with loved ones, dominate online activities, and binge-watch shows with no bother for connectivity issues. If you lose your connection, Smart Wireless technology and the Lenovo AI Engine of IdeaPad 5i 2-in-1 automatically detect the network and restore the connection for you. It is like having a reliable personal assistant by your side, so you can breeze through activities without disruptions.
A Lasting Commitment
Your commitment to environmental sustainability starts with your PC's energy conservation and recycled content. The product ships with a packaging cushion that contains 90% recycled plastic, built with 90% post-consumer recycled plastic in the power adapter case and 90% ocean-bound plastic in the system bag. Registered EPEAT® Gold and ENERGY STAR® certified, it fulfils the highest environmental performance criteria on product longevity, circular design, and energy efficiency.

Cutting edge, next-gen technology
The ThinkPad E14 Gen 2 laptop boasts a cutting-edge 11th Gen Intel® Core™ processor, so you get faster performance to power through your work tasks. Backed by up to 16GB of DDR4 memory and up to 1TB in Solid State Drive storage, this device confidently handles whatever jobs come your way.

Visuals that spark inspiration

Find extra time in your day

ThinkPad reliability
Like all ThinkPad laptops, the E14 Gen 2 is tested against 12 military-grade requirements and more than 200 quality checks. From the Arctic wilderness to desert dust storms, from zero-gravity to spills and drops, you can trust these laptops to handle whatever life throws your way.

product_description:

Powered by the Intel Ultra™ 5-125U 12-Core processor, this laptop handles multitasking and complex tasks with ease. It features DDR5 memory for faster data processing, a backlit keyboard for enhanced productivity in any lighting condition, and comes with a 2-year warranty for peace of mind. Perfect for work, study, or business on the go, the ThinkPad Edge E16 delivers power and functionality in a sleek design.
Key Features:
Enhanced Performance
With Intel® Core™ Ultra processors, the ThinkPad E16 Gen 2 (16″ Intel) laptop brings AI-assisted productivity to the forefront. Enjoy optimized performance with dedicated AI engines, including the low-power neural processing unit (NPU) that enables you to do much more on battery power. Multitask away, even when unplugged — turn on auto-framing, background blur, and low-light enhancement for your online meetings.
Accurate & Ergonomic Keyboard
The ThinkPad E16 G2 (16″ Intel) laptop features a full-sized keyboard that includes a numeric pad — perfect for financial services, data analysis, or any detailed tasks involving number crunching. Navigate with the TrackPad or the TrackPoint and leave your mouse behind. Plus, with a double tap of the little red nub, the ThinkPad TrackPoint Quick Menu opens to optimize audio-visuals, set alerts against muting, and even take notes with the Dictation Toolbar for handy speech-to-text transcription.
Sound Collaborator
The laptop boasts an impressive display, offering an exceptional visual experience. With a range of sharp and focused resolutions available, images are rendered with stunning detail and vibrancy. Keep your meetings in focus and collaboration to a maximum. This ThinkPad is ideal for anyone on the go or working from home. In addition, this laptop boasts Audio by Harman® and Dolby Atmos® that’ll help you rock out to your favorite media and sound crystal-clear during conference calls.
Ready to Work, Anywhere
We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H to create a balance of reliability and durability for all of our ThinkPad laptops. Meeting or exceeding 12 standards, 26 procedures, and 200+ quality checks ensure that these devices run in extreme conditions, including harsh variables like Arctic wilderness, desert dust storms, extreme temps, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.
Recycled Components & Eco-conscious Packaging
Even with all its productivity and collaboration-enhancing features, this ThinkPad was designed with recycling in mind. We used recycled post-consumer content (PCC) in various components. The battery pack is made of 25% PCC recycled plastic, which is a big step towards sustainability. The speaker enclosure is 30% PCC recycled plastic, while the AC Adaptor rocks a cool 90% PCC recycled plastic composition. Plus, the packaging is completely plastic-free and 100% recyclable – and is Forest Stewardship Council® certified, so you can feel good about choosing this laptop.
Safe & Secure Computing
Biometrics provide extra protection on the ThinkPad E16 Gen 2 (16″ Intel) laptop — from the optional fingerprint reader integrated with the power button to the facial recognition software that works with the optional IR camera. Our robust suite of security solutions, ThinkShield, includes discrete Trusted Platform Module (dTPM) 2.0 that ensures the encryption of vital data. Moreover, it uses AI-enabled Intel® Threat Detection Technology to proactively guard against threats such as ransomware and cryptojacking. With ThinkPad, rest assured, that your security and asset protection are our utmost priority.

The screen and glass-fiber-coated backplate do devour fingerprints, though.
By comparison, Microsoft's 13-inch Surface Pro 8 is 9.3mm thick, weighs 891g and encompasses a footprint measuring 287mm by 208mm.
The 12.6-inch screen sits within moderately thin bezels that, Huawei claims, deliver a screen-to-body ratio of 90%. Our calculation, however, puts it much lower (70%), and also under the Surface Pro 8 under the identical method (84.2%). Still, although it's no 'minimal-bezel' device, the MateBook E 2022 doesn't look in any way old-fashioned.
The tablet isn't self-supporting – that's, it's no integrated kickstand as on many other 2-in-1 devices. In tablet mode, the MateBook E 2022 is handheld only.
I also had the Huawei M-Pencil (2nd generation), an optional extra costing €99. This stylus supports 4,096 pressure levels and tilt sensitivity, has 2ms latency and charges wirelessly when magnetically attached to the highest right fringe of the tablet.

If you choose Natural Tone within the Display Manager utility, the screen's color temperature is adjusted to match the ambient lighting; there's also a blue-light-reducing Eye Comfort setting here.
3- Wireless connectivity is nice as far because it goes – Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) and Bluetooth 5.2 – but there isn't any 4G or 5G mobile broadband option, which some prospective buyers may be searching for.
